measurement.baselineBuild: Only test bridge/probe added; Player/GameScene/main gameplay logic unchanged from baseCommit.
measurement.method: Test-only query config + full Game.step calls with exact 1000/hz render delta; real Playwright keyboard events; per-worldstep body sampling.
measurement.physics: 60 Hz; fixed dt=1/60; one World.update/postUpdate and one Player.step per tick
measurement.result: All distance and landing-time differences versus 60Hz are exactly zero after the fix.
measurement.input: All three rates: single jump consumes 1 edge; double jump consumes 2 edges and triggers exactly once; short jump/attack consume 1 edge each; held attack still attacks twice per second. At 144Hz short pulses span a render frame with zero physics ticks.

regressionFixes.reason: The return-position test paused a freshly created scene before the new body's first physics synchronization.
regressionFixes.fix: Wait for onGround && state2 === 'ground' before pausing and checking the return location; no sleep or timeout increase.
